extraCertificates.description: Additional certificates for the agent: either mount a volume and name it in fromVolume, or set path to a directory that is already in the container.

path.description: Directory in the container the agent loads additional certificates from (sets STEADYBIT_AGENT_EXTRA_CERTS_PATH).

fromVolume.description: Name of a volume (see agent.extraVolumes) mounted at the agent's default extra-certs directory.
